Based on the photos showing characteristic pustules and crusting, this strongly suggests neonatal gonococcal conjunctivitis with disseminated skin infection. The mother's history of untreated gonorrhea is highly concerning for vertical transmission. I will wait for the PCR and culture results to confirm the specific pathogen before finalizing the treatment plan.
